title: Talented Music star, DiscoBT is currently making waves with the release of his recent single "Hopin"
htmlContent:
American-based artist, DiscoBT is a multi-talented singer and songwriter currently making waves with the release of his recent song “Hopin.” The lyrical genius is presently mainly focusing on alternative rap and R&B.

DiscoBT, on his recent song “Hopin,” brings a mainstream sound that gives it an appeal that you know will help it travel worldwide. His vocal performance is masterful in its tone to match the energy needed to deliver impressive writing and ensure his audiences keep coming back for more.
